mirrorHoles.Name: Mirror holes into the level below
mirrorHoles.Hint: When a hole or stair is cut into a floor, cut the same opening into the ceiling of the level below.

autoTag.Name: Auto-tag new placeables to the active level
autoTag.Hint: Walls, tiles, sounds and notes placed while Floorer is open are tagged to the active level. Lights get elevation only and stay untagged so light spills through openings.

sealBasements.Name: Seal basements by default
sealBasements.Hint: Generated basement levels see only themselves.
